day_line: A jewel on an Ox day. Polished and patient: good for careful work and steady progress, easy to be too hard on yourself.

lines.Yang Wood: Your manager spots your effort today. Send the update early and keep it short.
lines.Yin Wood: Monday squeezes you today. Block an hour for the hard task; mute the chat.
lines.Yang Fire: Careful work pays today. Clear the expense claims before lunch.
lines.Yin Fire: A new task could open doors today. Say you're interested, then ask questions.
lines.Yang Earth: Your clear view helps today. Say it in the meeting, in two sentences.
lines.Yin Earth: Monday goes lighter for you. Bring kueh for the team; calories shared.
lines.Yang Metal: A colleague pushes the same idea today. Join forces; there's credit for two.
lines.Yin Metal: Good allies sit near you today. Ask the colleague you trust to check your draft.
lines.Yang Water: Someone experienced helps today. Ask early; it saves you hours.
lines.Yin Water: Trust your hunch today. Write the idea down; test it by Wednesday.
